simple.meaning: אַרְדְּ (ʼArd) is a Hebrew word meaning “Ard , the name of two Israelites.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אַרְדְּ (H714) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 46:21, with occurrences in Genesis, Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַרְדְּ (H714) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אַרְדְּ (H714) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אַרְדְּ (ʼArd) / H714 is traced through Genesis 46:21, Numbers 26:40 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
